document_number.label: Nomor dokumen
document_number.description: The main number that identifies this document itself, not a referenced order, contract or tax invoice.

document_date.label: Tanggal dokumen
document_date.description: The issue date of this document, not a due date, period or signature place.

issuer_name.label: Penerbit
issuer_name.description: The organization or person that issued this document.

recipient_name.label: Penerima
recipient_name.description: The organization or person this document is addressed to.

subject.label: Perihal
subject.description: The title or subject line of the document as printed.

purchase_order_number.label: Nomor PO
purchase_order_number.description: The purchase order number this document refers to.

contract_number.label: Nomor kontrak
contract_number.description: The contract or agreement number this document refers to.

reference_document_number.label: Nomor dokumen acuan
reference_document_number.description: The number of another document this document is based on, when printed as a reference.

due_date.label: Jatuh tempo
due_date.description: The payment due date, only when printed as such.

billing_period.label: Periode tagihan
billing_period.description: The billing or service period exactly as printed, e.g. a month or a date range.

subtotal_amount.label: Subtotal
subtotal_amount.description: The amount before printed tax or adjustments.

tax_base_amount.label: DPP
tax_base_amount.description: The tax base amount (Dasar Pengenaan Pajak) when printed.

tax_amount.label: Pajak
tax_amount.description: The printed tax amount (for example PPN/VAT).

total_amount.label: Total
total_amount.description: The final total amount to be paid or received for this document.

currency_code.label: Mata uang
currency_code.description: The currency explicitly printed on the document, such as IDR or Rp.

tax_id.label: NPWP
tax_id.description: A taxpayer identification number (NPWP) printed on the document.

seller_name.label: Penjual / PKP
seller_name.description: The seller or taxable entrepreneur (Pengusaha Kena Pajak) on a tax invoice.

seller_tax_id.label: NPWP penjual
seller_tax_id.description: The taxpayer number of the seller on a tax invoice.

buyer_name.label: Pembeli
buyer_name.description: The buyer of goods or services on a tax invoice.

buyer_tax_id.label: NPWP pembeli
buyer_tax_id.description: The taxpayer number of the buyer on a tax invoice.

tax_invoice_number.label: Nomor seri faktur pajak
tax_invoice_number.description: The tax invoice code and serial number (Kode dan Nomor Seri Faktur Pajak).

payer_name.label: Telah terima dari
payer_name.description: The party the payment was received from, on a receipt.

payment_purpose.label: Untuk pembayaran
payment_purpose.description: What the payment on a receipt is for, as printed.

amount_in_words.label: Terbilang
amount_in_words.description: The amount written in words, exactly as printed.

first_party_name.label: Pihak pertama
first_party_name.description: The party named as the first party (Pihak Pertama).

second_party_name.label: Pihak kedua
second_party_name.description: The party named as the second party (Pihak Kedua).

contract_amount.label: Nilai kontrak
contract_amount.description: The contract value as printed; not a payment or invoice amount.

work_description.label: Uraian pekerjaan
work_description.description: The work or service the document is about.

inspection_date.label: Tanggal pemeriksaan
inspection_date.description: The date the inspection took place.

inspection_result.label: Hasil pemeriksaan
inspection_result.description: The inspection outcome exactly as written; never an approval decision.

payment_stage.label: Termin
payment_stage.description: The payment stage or term (termin) when mentioned.

payment_amount.label: Nilai pembayaran
payment_amount.description: A payment amount printed explicitly; never computed from a percentage.

payment_period.label: Periode pembayaran
payment_period.description: The period a payment relates to, as printed.

service_description.label: Layanan
service_description.description: The service or utility whose usage is reported.

service_period_start.label: Awal periode
service_period_start.description: The first day of the reported service period.

service_period_end.label: Akhir periode
service_period_end.description: The last day of the reported service period.

provider_name.label: Penyedia
provider_name.description: The provider of the reported service.

handover_description.label: Objek serah terima
handover_description.description: The work or goods handed over.

handover_result.label: Hasil serah terima
handover_result.description: The handover outcome as written; never an approval decision.

start_date.label: Tanggal mulai
start_date.description: The start date of the contract or order period.

end_date.label: Tanggal selesai
end_date.description: The end date of the contract or order period.

requested_amount.label: Nilai yang diminta
requested_amount.description: The amount requested for payment in a payment request.

payee_name.label: Penerima pembayaran
payee_name.description: The party that should receive the requested payment.

bank_account_holder.label: Nama rekening
bank_account_holder.description: The bank account holder name printed for the payment, never a balance or credential.
